description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of two methods—Greedy and RPG—applied to two different-sized language models, CodeLlama-7B and CodeLlama-34B, across four evaluation metrics: EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP. The vertical axis represents performance on a scale from 0.0 to 1.0, while the horizontal axis lists the metrics. Each metric has four bars representing the four combinations: Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) in blue, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) in orange, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) in green, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) in dark orange. For the EGP metric, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) achieves the highest performance (approximately 0.9), followed by RPG (CodeLlama-34B) (approximately 0.9), Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) (approximately 0.6), and Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) (approximately 0.6). In the TR-N and TR-S metrics, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) performs better than Greedy (CodeLlama-7B), and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) outperforms Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), with RPG (CodeLlama-34B) achieving the highest performance in TR-S (approximately 0.7). For the CCP metric, RPG (CodeLlama-34B) shows the highest performance (approximately 0.95), followed by RPG (CodeLlama-7B) (approximately 0.75), Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) (approximately 0.7), and Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) (approximately 0.4). The upward arrow (↑) next to EGP and CCP indicates higher values are better, while the downward arrow (↓) next to TR-N and TR-S indicates lower values are better. The results are presented as average values across three scenarios on the CodeRepetEval dataset.
